s1.syndrome_frame: syndromic pigmentary retinal dystrophy with multisystem involvement
key_facts: bilateral cataract extraction with 13D monofocal intraocular lenses 3 years earlier
joint hyperextensibility of the hands, feet, ankles, and knees
best-corrected visual acuity 2/10 in each eye

raw.syndrome_frame: syndromic pigmentary retinal dystrophy with multisystem involvement
key_facts: bilateral cataract extraction with 13D monofocal intraocular lenses 3 years earlier
joint hyperextensibility of the hands, feet, ankles, and knees
best-corrected visual acuity 2/10 in each eye

shortlist.label: Bardet-Biedl syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: matches syndromic pigmentary retinal dystrophy with multisystem involvement, including intellectual disability, obesity, and retinal dystrophy

shortlist.label: Cockayne syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: consistent with multisystem involvement, including retinal dystrophy, intellectual disability, and microcephaly

shortlist.label: Alstrom syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: aligns with syndromic pigmentary retinal dystrophy, intellectual disability, and multisystem involvement, including obesity and hyperextensibility

shortlist.label: Senior-Loken syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: matches retinal dystrophy with multisystem involvement, including intellectual disability and renal issues, although renal issues are not mentioned in the case

shortlist.label: Leber congenital amaurosis
shortlist.why_kept: consistent with severe rod-cone retinal dystrophy, although the age of onset and presence of multisystem involvement are not typical for this condition

raw.rationale: The combination of severe rod-cone retinal dystrophy, high bilateral myopia, intellectual disability, microcephaly, truncal obesity, and joint hyperextensibility in the patient matches the characteristic features of Bardet-Biedl syndrome, which is a syndromic form of retinal dystrophy.

rejected.label: Cockayne syndrome
rejected.why: Cockayne syndrome typically presents with more pronounced neurological features, such as ataxia and sensorineural hearing loss, which are not mentioned in the vignette.

rejected.label: Alstrom syndrome
rejected.why: Alstrom syndrome is characterized by a combination of retinal dystrophy, obesity, and sensorineural hearing loss, but the patient's features, such as microcephaly and joint hyperextensibility, do not align closely with Alstrom syndrome.

rejected.label: Senior-Loken syndrome
rejected.why: Senior-Loken syndrome is primarily associated with retinal dystrophy and renal disease, which is not mentioned in the vignette.

rejected.label: Leber congenital amaurosis
rejected.why: Leber congenital amaurosis is a nonsyndromic form of retinal dystrophy that typically presents in infancy, and the patient's additional systemic features, such as intellectual disability and microcephaly, are not characteristic of this condition.
